label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_01
text: I see the guard has been dealt with. Good job.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_02
text: That base belongs to Team Star’s Fairy crew—\nthe Ruchbah Squad.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_03
text: Their boss, Ortega, is the mechanic of the team.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_04
text: He may be the youngest of the bosses, but his\nbattle skills are no joke. Underestimate him, and\r\nthings’ll go south for you quickly.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_05
text: He’s also a real “lead from the back” type—he\ngets his grunts to do all the dirty work for him.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_06
text: But his weak point is his short fuse. Get him good\nand angry, and he’ll march out to the front lines\r\nto deal with you himself.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_07
text: In terms of tactics...there’s nothing else for it but\nto take down all the lackeys he sends your way.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_08
text: Just tough it out until Ortega shows up, and go\nfrom there.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_fairy_020_cassiopeia_10
text: Ring the bell on the gates once you’re ready to\nkick off this phase of the operation.\c\nTime to wipe the Ruchbah Squad off the map![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
